---
title: "Before the session"
---
Before the session, read the background page and check that the slides of the session load on the machine that you will bring. There is nothing to install and nothing to register for.

## 1. Background {#the-case-study}

[Read the background](../../background.qmd){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"}

The background page presents the claim on which the session works, and how the five analysts of the SCORE robustness study (Aczel et al. 2026) came to different conclusions about it.

## 2. The slides {#the-deck}

[Open the slides at Task 1](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

The slides of the session run R inside your browser, with the data already in place. Open them once on the machine and in the browser that you will use (a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox), wait until the setup cell shows a "Run Code" button, and run it. If the slides do not load, try another browser, and tell the facilitator before the session. The browser lab holds the same tasks and is the fallback.

## 3. On the day

Bring a laptop and its charger.
